USB-Me / Evaluation review / September 20, 2026

# Three models. The same 150 tests.

A combined review of Nemotron 3 Nano 4B, Phi-4 Mini 3.8B, and Qwen3 14B, with every result aligned by case ID.

**Automated scores — human review pending.** All 450 model responses are included. Speech and answer keys have not been human-reviewed. These are single runs on exposed development cases; they do not establish a general model ranking. No real tools executed.

## Model scores

### Nemotron 3 Nano 4B

56 / 150 passed · 37.3%

94 failed automated checks

1.303 s average request · 2.84 GB model file

### Phi-4 Mini 3.8B

51 / 150 passed · 34.0%

99 failed automated checks

1.325 s average request · 2.49 GB model file

### Qwen3 14B

83 / 150 passed · 55.3%

67 failed automated checks

3.962 s average request · 9.00 GB model file

## What the runs show

Qwen3 passed **27 more cases than Nemotron (+18.0 percentage points)** and **32 more than Phi (+21.3 points)**. It had the highest automated pass count in every difficulty tier, with an average request time 3.04× Nemotron’s and 2.99× Phi’s.

All three passed **40** cases; all three failed **56**. The remaining **54** cases have mixed pass/fail results and are useful starting points for review.

## Timing and model size

| Metric | Nemotron 3 Nano 4B | Phi-4 Mini 3.8B | Qwen3 14B |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mean request | 1.303 s | 1.325 s | 3.962 s |
| Median request | 1.184 s | 1.268 s | 3.574 s |
| 95th percentile request | 2.125 s | 2.082 s | 6.943 s |
| Sum of request times | 195.393 s | 198.725 s | 594.347 s |
| Complete run wall time | 217.323 s | 219.702 s | 633.939 s |
| GGUF file size (decimal GB) | 2.837 GB | 2.492 GB | 9.002 GB |

Request timing uses recorded elapsed\_seconds; wall time uses the run start and finish timestamps and includes overhead. The 95th percentile uses nearest rank. File size is disk size, not runtime memory. All three runtimes recorded an NVIDIA L4 (23,034 MiB); these are observed timings from one run each.

## Source runs and comparison conditions

Compiled from the three archived results.json files. Each archive matches its corresponding completed pilot run byte for byte at compilation. Case IDs, inputs, environments, answer keys, and human checks match across models. Dataset and system prompt hashes were verified against the saved files; output schema files are identical.

Shared settings: Q4\_K\_M quantization; 4,096 context; one slot; temperature 0; seed 42; 512 maximum output tokens; prompt caching disabled in requests; non-streaming requests; reasoning\_effort none; 120-second timeout; zero retries. Each model uses its own chat template. Nemotron and Qwen explicitly pass enable\_thinking: false; Phi omits that template argument. Runner versions and model weights differ.
